user.title: Energy Price Graph
user.description: Adds a dynamic electricity price graph to the built-in Energy dashboard. The price sensors are read from your energy settings (Electricity grid → costs / compensation). You can change the options afterwards via Configure. Refresh your browser once after setup.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Energy Price Graph is already set up.

init.title: Energy Price Graph options
init.description: Changes apply the next time you open the Energy dashboard.

graph.name: Price graph
graph.description: How the price graph looks and on which tabs it is shown.

data.views: Show the price graph on tabs

data_description.period: Auto (fine) shows every price step (5-minute data, so quarter-hour prices change exactly at :00, :15, :30 and :45) for periods up to a week within the recorder history, and hourly or daily averages for longer periods. Auto uses hourly averages for a day. 5-minute data is kept as long as your recorder keeps history (purge_keep_days, default 10 days).
data_description.line_style: Straight connects the points directly. Stepped shows the exact price per period. Smooth draws a rounded curve.
data_description.views: Tabs of the Energy dashboard where the electricity price graph is shown.
data_description.show_export: Adds a second line when the export price is a different sensor than the import price.
data_description.minmax: Also draws the lowest and highest price within each period.

current.name: Current price
current.description: Chips with the current price in the header of the graph.

data_description.show_current: Small chips in the card header with the current price.
data_description.show_price_colors: Green when the current price is favourable compared to today's average price (the whole day when a forecast sensor is set, otherwise the prices so far today) (low for import and gas, high for export), orange around the average, red when unfavourable.

average.name: Average price
average.description: Card below Energy distribution on the Electricity tab.

data_description.show_average: Card below Energy distribution on the Electricity tab with your average import and export price for the selected period, next to the average market price.
data_description.show_savings: Shows in euros how much better or worse you did than the market average, for import and export separately and in total.

gas.name: Gas
gas.description: Price graph on the Gas tab.

data_description.show_gas: Price graph on the Gas tab, using the gas price sensor from your energy settings.

forecast.name: Forecast (upcoming prices)
forecast.description: Choose a sensor that has the upcoming prices in its attributes (for example Nord Pool, ENTSO-e, Zonneplan or Frank Energie). Upcoming prices are drawn as a dashed line; open tomorrow in the date picker to see tomorrow.

data_description.forecast_import_entity: Leave empty for no forecast line.
data_description.forecast_export_entity: Leave empty for no forecast line.
data_description.forecast_gas_entity: Leave empty for no forecast line.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Overrides for sensors, title and names.

data_description.title: Leave empty for the default title.
data_description.import_entity: Leave empty to use the sensor from your energy settings.
data_description.export_entity: Leave empty to use the sensor from your energy settings.
data_description.gas_entity: Leave empty to use the sensor from your energy settings.
